statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-62901 (GHSA-m93f-wj8c-rp8p) is a .NET denial of service issue in System.Net.WebSockets: an unchecked input used as a loop condition lets a remote attacker deny service over a network. Microsoft lists Windows, Linux and macOS as the affected platforms and the .NET 10.0 runtime packs, including linux-musl-x64 and linux-musl-arm64, as affected from 10.0.0 through 10.0.10 and fixed in 10.0.11 (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-m93f-wj8c-rp8p, https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/428, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/10.0/10.0.11/10.0.11.md). DHI dotnet10-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 10 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 264 packages of the twelve published builds (10.0.2-r0, 10.0.3-r0, 10.0.4-r0, 10.0.5-r0, 10.0.6-r0, 10.0.7-r0, 10.0.8-r0, 10.0.9-r0, 10.0.10-r0, 10.0.13-r0, 10.0.14-r0 and 10.0.15-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the files inside the nupkg and other zip archives they hold: every build ships the Microsoft.NETCore.App shared framework, which holds System.Net.WebSockets, at its own .NET version, in dotnet10-runtime and in the .NET SDK held by dotnet10-runtime-bootstrap, and the .NET runtime packs at that version in dotnet10-runtime-bootstrap: 10.0.2 to 10.0.10 in the first nine builds and 10.0.13 or later from 10.0.13-r0 on. The range ends at 10.0.13-r0 because it is the first published build with the fix.

CVE-2026-62901 (GHSA-m93f-wj8c-rp8p) is a .NET denial of service issue in System.Net.WebSockets: an unchecked input used as a loop condition lets an attacker deny service over a network. Microsoft lists the .NET 8.0 runtime packs, including linux-musl-x64 and linux-musl-arm64, as affected from 8.0.0 through 8.0.29 and fixed in 8.0.30 (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-m93f-wj8c-rp8p, https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/428, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/8.0/8.0.30/8.0.30.md). DHI dotnet8-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 8 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 220 packages of the ten published builds (8.0.23-r0, 8.0.24-r0, 8.0.25-r0, 8.0.26-r0, 8.0.27-r0, 8.0.29-r0, 8.0.31-r0, 8.0.32-r0, 8.0.33-r0 and 8.0.34-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the files inside the nupkg and other zip archives they hold: every build ships the Microsoft.NETCore.App shared framework, which holds System.Net.WebSockets.dll, at its own .NET version, in dotnet8-runtime and in the .NET SDK held by dotnet8-runtime-bootstrap, and that version's runtime pack and NativeAOT compiler pack held by dotnet8-runtime-bootstrap carry System.Net.WebSockets.dll at the same version: 8.0.23 to 8.0.29 in the first six builds and 8.0.31 or later from 8.0.31-r0 on. The other copies of System.Net.WebSockets.dll are reference assemblies with no implementation code and 3 KB .NET Framework facades in the SDK build extensions and a reference package. No 8.0.30 build was published; the build after 8.0.29-r0 is 8.0.31-r0. The range ends at 8.0.31-r0 because it is the first published build with the fix.

CVE-2026-62901 (GHSA-m93f-wj8c-rp8p) is a .NET denial of service issue in System.Net.WebSockets: an unchecked loop condition on network input lets an unauthenticated attacker cause a denial of service. Microsoft lists Windows, Linux and macOS as affected platforms and the .NET 9.0 runtime packs, including linux-musl-x64 and linux-musl-arm64, as affected from 9.0.0 through 9.0.18 and fixed in 9.0.19: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-m93f-wj8c-rp8p, https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/428, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/9.0/9.0.19/9.0.19.md. DHI dotnet9-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 9 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 242 packages of the eleven published builds (9.0.12-r0, 9.0.13-r0, 9.0.14-r0, 9.0.15-r0, 9.0.16-r0, 9.0.17-r0, 9.0.18-r0, 9.0.20-r0, 9.0.21-r0, 9.0.22-r0 and 9.0.23-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the debug packages and the files inside the nupkg, zip and tar.gz archives they hold: every build ships System.Net.WebSockets.dll at its own .NET version, in the Microsoft.NETCore.App shared framework of dotnet9-runtime and of the .NET SDK held by dotnet9-runtime-bootstrap, and in that version's runtime pack and NativeAOT compiler pack held by dotnet9-runtime-bootstrap; the other copies of System.Net.WebSockets.dll are reference assemblies with no implementation code and 3 KB .NET Framework (net461) and .NET Standard 2.0 facade assemblies in the SDK build extensions and in reference NuGet packages, which hold no WebSockets implementation. That version is 9.0.12 to 9.0.18 in the first seven builds and 9.0.20 or later from 9.0.20-r0 on. No 9.0.19 build was published; the build after 9.0.18-r0 is 9.0.20-r0. The range ends at 9.0.20-r0 because it is the first published build with the fix.
